NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VIII: OUR OWN STORIES, SKILLS AND FUTURE (LCH-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
From the owner's Volume IV concepts (301-400): telling our own stories, who owns a song or a design, research the village asks for, caregivers and builders, seeds that came home, makers and stargazers, terrible singing, newcomers who stay, and an island that belongs to its people.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The stepping stones over the stream are hard for elders and children: build a wide bridge, or add a rail to the stones.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The only way across the stream is a line of slippery stepping stones. (subject), who uses a crutch, has stopped crossing to the far gardens. So have several elders and all the smallest children. (friend) knows how to build. What should (friend) build?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) and a dozen helpers build a wide, flat bridge with rails on both sides. It takes a month. (subject) is the first across. Everyone uses it, even people who used to hop the stones for fun.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) builds a rope rail along the stones, quickly. It helps a little. (subject) can cross on dry days. On wet days, (subject.he/she) still cannot. (friend) starts on the bridge the next season.
